title: Curbside Pickup with Mobile Emulation and Live Vehicle Arrival

scenarios.name: Complete Curbside Mobile Arrival and Vehicle Verification

steps.text: Customer clears shopping cart and navigates to "huzeif-test" category
Customer adds product to cart, proceeds to checkout, and selects "Curbside Pickup"
Customer turns off "Pay At Store", selects Credit Card, places order, and captures Order ID and Confirmation Code
Fulfillment employee opens Pending Orders, picks all items, and marks order Ready
Customer opens order in Mobile Device View (Pixel 5)
Customer verifies "Ready For Pickup" status and completes mobile vehicle arrival submission with Spot "Spot - A", Color "Black", Maker "Acura", Model "CL"
Fulfillment employee navigates to Ready Orders and opens the curbside order
Fulfillment employee verifies Curbside Pickup method and Parking Spot / Car Info blocks
Fulfillment employee completes handover with confirmation code transitioning order to Fulfilled
